primaryAnalysis.independence: one case = one paired unit; the 2 repetitions per case are repeated measurements of the SAME unit, never independent samples
primaryAnalysis.reductionRule: reduceCaseLevel (lib/ceb002-stats.mjs, test-anchored): a case counts B-worse iff B failed >=1 rep AND C passed BOTH reps; symmetric for C-worse; every mixed outcome is concordant and never enters the discordant count — rule FIXED BEFORE any results

test.implementation: lib/ceb002-stats.mjs mcnemarExactPValue — exact binomial enumeration, no asymptotic approximation

primaryAnalysis.role: extreme-effect veto gate ONLY — the primary statistical output is descriptive effect estimation (per-case pair detail, discordance rate, direction)
primaryAnalysis.powerLimitation: n=8 exact McNemar (two-sided alpha=0.05) rejects when >=6 discordant case-level units ALL point in the same direction with the rest concordant — i.e. (6,0) p=0.03125, (7,0) p=0.01563, (8,0) p=0.00781 or the symmetric reverse; (5,0) p=0.0625 does NOT reject. Max power 0.1445 (=37/256, reached at pd=0.5 delta=0.5); at delta=0.25/pd=0.5 power is 0.024; conservative null size ~0.00004. CONFIRMATORY TESTING IS INFEASIBLE at this round's sample size — the exact test serves as an extreme-effect veto gate only

referenceViews.status: reference only — heterogeneous tier mix (L1 anchor + boundary + discriminative)
referenceViews.independence: 16 independent case-level units but not the primary analysis object

referenceViews.status: reference only — NON-INDEPENDENT (repetitions of the same case are correlated)
referenceViews.forbiddenUse: must never be presented as independent samples or used to inflate the independent n

escalation.rule: NONE — fixed 2 repetitions; no result-driven sample-size adjustment; any confirmatory study requires a SEPARATE preregistration and fresh Owner authorization

confounds.name: B/C sentence-count ratio 2:5
confounds.note: payloads are CEB-001 frozen texts reused verbatim; this material imbalance is reported with every B-vs-C comparison

supports: exploratory comparison of these two specific payloads (B principle text vs C summary text)
descriptive effect estimation with per-case detail
boundary-tier negative-transfer observation across five situations
difficulty-gradient ceiling check (L1 anchor vs L2/L3)
doesNotSupport: causal attribution to the principle-abstraction mechanism (confound + exploratory sample)
inference to any broader task population (the 16 frozen cases are the study object)
confirmatory conclusions (n=8 power ceiling is a mathematical fact)

freezeRequirement: Owner approval required for: (1) suite freeze, (2) preregistration in force, (3) execution authorization — none granted by this draft
